headline: PM defends 0.25% disaster resilience levy
summary: Barbados' prime minister defended a 0.25% disaster resilience levy in draft legislation. Families earning $75,000 or less could receive up to $200,000 in grants for home strengthening.
why: Levies and fiscal measures affect business costs and public finances in small island economies. Disaster-resilience spending is also relevant to insurance and construction activity.
